Analysis: I have reviewed `src/ezdxf/attsync.py`. The methods `sync_attribs`, `attrib_placements`, etc., mentioned in the task description are indeed NOT present as methods on `Insert`, `BlockLayout`, or `doc.blocks` in the current codebase.
